newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA YUAN INTERBANK MARKET TURNOVER FALLS IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: CHINA YUAN INTERBANK MARKET TURNOVER FALLS IN JULY.

text.p: The Shanghai-based China local currency interbank market traded 41.717 billion yuan in July, down from 46.658 billion yuan in June, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
Average daily turnover in July was 1.896 billion yuan, down from 2.22 billion yuan in June, the newspaper said.

All interbank rates fell in July with the weighted average rate of the market losing 0.47 percentage points to 10.61 percent by the end of July against the end of June, reflecting an ample supply of money on the market, it said.
